turns.en: Are we done? That was an hour.

تينتين-- تنين دي إن، no. د-- uh، دإي إن.

turns.text: Oh, that's right, I'm supposed to add
a place for you to add notes.

The room, no, the room's medicine.

turns.text: Oh، it just cleared. Oh، no. uh،

turns.text: It wants you to say أدوية. Don't use أدوية. دواء is...

Oh، today's schedule is different from what we planned for last night.

turns.en: You already-- did you say 'shu' or 'la shu'?

turns.text: My most favorite thing is to swim.

turns.en: Oh, I said this wrong; my favorite thing.

turns.text: مفضل عندي. No L، N، N، No L بس للسباحة.
turns.en: Favorite for me; no 'l', only with swimming.

ليش؟ Why did it assume that you're talking to a woman؟ You could be talking to a man.

turns.text: Yeah, I need to, I need to fix the, the correction.
Uh, كل أديش بزوروك يا بزوروك.
turns.en: Uh, as often as I visit you, I visit you.

turns.text: That's the one. I had to look that one up.
You ha-- [تنفس مفاجئ] what did you look up؟
turns.en: You, what did you look up?

turns.text: Okay, then I intended for you to remember كل قديش، بس بش وشكلة بيزوروا.
turns.en: Okay, I meant for you to remember 'kull 'adeish' (how much each), but it's no problem that you forgot 'bizoorou'.

turns.text: Yeah, I remember the كل أديش.
turns.en: Yeah, I remember 'kull 'adeish', meaning how much each.

turns.text: بس، uh, you've been doing it, you've do-- [تتلعثم] been doing a better job، so that's great.
turns.en: But you've been doing a better job, so that's great.

turns.text: More collocations, I think, until we get it right. [laughs] Okay.

turns.en: May God bless you, thank you.
You're welcome. Yalla, I'll see you.
